description: Image Description: The image shows a clay oven with an open metal door. The exterior of the oven is rough and appears weathered, with visible cracks and discoloration. Inside the oven, there are several metal shelves arranged horizontally. At the bottom, there is a fire burning with visible flames and glowing embers, suggesting that the oven is currently in use. The interior appears slightly sooty due to the fire. The oven is situated outdoors, as indicated by the stone or concrete surface visible around it
